roles.title: PCA/CNA (Caregiver)
roles.summary: Full- and part-time in-home care in Missoula and Great Falls, starting at $19.75/hour. Day, evening, and Friday–Sunday availability is especially helpful. Duties include assisting with activities of daily living (ADLs), bathing, hygiene, meal preparation, mobility, social supervision, homemaking, and life-coach or companion hours. Requires a current CNA or PCA certification (waiver or training may be available), compassion, ability to lift 50 lb, a valid driver's license, current vehicle insurance, and reliable transportation.

roles.title: LPN/RN (Nurse)
roles.summary: Part-time and full-time nursing in Missoula and Great Falls, primarily shift work (often 4–12 hours). Nurses perform nursing tasks while also handling activities of daily living and home management. Shorter visits may include medication management, bowel-care programs, and foot care. Requires a current RN or LPN certification (waiver or training may be available), compassion, ability to lift 50 lb, a valid driver's license, current vehicle insurance, and reliable transportation.
